facts.business: RTS Power Corporation Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of GI Wires and Strips through its wholly owned subsidiary Reengus Wires Private Limited, and operates in the power sector with focus on transformer segments and export markets.

segments.name: Manufacturing of GI Wires and Strips

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company expects the capacity enhancement and downstream expansion being undertaken by its wholly owned subsidiary, Reengus Wires Private Limited, to support future growth, subject to market conditions and improved capacity utilisation.

key_risks: Lower execution of orders leading to revenue decline
Dependence on subsidiary Reengus Wires Private Limited for future growth
Trade receivables with significant amounts outstanding for considerable periods
Inventory valuation risk due to slow-moving and older inventory items
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties include: Subsidiary Reengus Wires Private Limited (interest income Rs 9.00 lakhs, sales Rs 15.49 lakhs, rental income Rs 15.75 lakhs, purchases Rs 360.30 lakhs); Key Management Personnel remuneration (Rajendra Bhutoria Rs 21.00 lakhs, Abhay Bhutoria Rs 39.00 lakhs, Siddharth Bhutoria Rs 46.10 lakhs); Other related parties including Suchir Industries Private Limited (rent paid Rs 26.46 lakhs, sales Rs 356.88 lakhs), Bhutoria Brothers Private Limited (rent paid Rs 0.48 lakhs), and others.
